## Help GPROXY reach the app stores

Your sponsorship helps cover the developer accounts needed to submit GPROXY to mobile app stores:

- Google Play developer account — $25, one-time
- Apple Developer Program — $99 per year

Once approved and listed, you can install GPROXY from your phone’s app store and receive updates through the store.

Sponsorship also supports ongoing maintenance, provider compatibility, and new features.
